name: PriceDisplay
description: The only way to render a fare, fee or total. Displays amounts given to it; never calculates them.

provenance.tag: Rec; currency-code format and "Fares from" prefix: A · unverified; Cash+Miles and free seat selection: Official

props.name: amount
props.description: { amountMinor, currency }, the same type as the quote. Minor units avoid floating-point errors; decimals come from the ISO 4217 currency (JPY 0, USD 2, KWD 3). null with free set.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatted with Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: 'currency', currencyDisplay: 'code', numberingSystem: 'latn' }). Shows the currency code, e.g. "USD 899". Latin digits in every language (D15).

source.tag: A · unverified (currency code display); Latin digits: Rec (D15)

props.name: originalAmount
props.description: Shown with strikethrough in --color-text-subtle. Screen readers hear "was USD 1,099" (visually hidden text).

source.tag: Official: seats can be paid with Cash+Miles
Official: some fares include free seat selection

props.name: size
props.description: Amount: body-sm / heading-3 / heading-2. Prefix and currency: caption / body-sm.

props.name: align
props.description: Fares on result cards align end.

requirements: Reads as one phrase: "Fares from USD 899".
The struck-through original price gets visually hidden text, "was USD 1,099", because strikethrough is not announced.

rtl: Intl.NumberFormat places the currency code on the correct side; wrap the output in <bdi> inside Arabic text.
Latin digits (numberingSystem 'latn') in all languages (Rec, configurable per market).
rules: Never compute an amount: it comes from the server quote or offer data (D16).
